| Risk | Severity | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **GPU cost on long OpenEvolve runs** | High | Budget-ledger + tiered scoring; run the "inner loop" on ML surrogates only, keep DFT/Vina on top-N |

| **Claude Science adds a matching open repo** | Low–Med | Differentiate on local-first, Pareto-native, public leaderboards (Phase 6) |
| **Scope creep into "build our own Boltz"** | Med | **Don't.** Build on top of open models; contribute upstream instead |
| **Evaluator overfitting to the scoring proxy** | High | Multi-objective Pareto (not weighted single-score); manual verification step baked into the run report |

{"content": """"Drug-discovery example -- Phase 2, item 1 (roadmap).

Docking-driven scaffold evolution behind ``OptimizeService.evolve()`` with the
three-objective Pareto front (Vina / docking + QED + SA).

Runs fully offline (deterministic surrogate docking until a Vina adapter
supplies real per-candidate affinities; RDKit QED/SA when installed). The
whole run stays inside ``runs/<id>/``: scored.jsonl trajectory, manifest,
artifacts -- reproducible with the command below.

Usage, from the repo root::

    python3 scripts/drug_evolve_example.py \
        --seeds CCO C1=CC=CC=C1O CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O c1ccc(O)cc1O \
        --iterations 6 --population 8 --max-evals 80 --seed 1337

The PDBQT/docking path (when AutoDock Vina + a receptor are available) is a
``docking_fn`` -- wire it in by passing it to :func:`opensciencelab.drugdiscovery.drug_evolve`;
the example wires one automatically if ``opensciencelab.docking`` is importable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))

from opensciencelab import Candidate  # noqa: E402
from opensciencelab.services import default_services  # noqa: E402
from opensciencelab.drugdiscovery import drug_evolve  # noqa: E402


def _optional_docking_fn():
    """Pick up a real Vina adapter if one is wired in (Phase 3 item 2);
    otherwise None -> the surrogate objective keeps the run honest."""
    try:
        from opensciencelab.docking import vina_objective  # type: ignore  # noqa: F401
    except Exception:
        return None
    from opensciencelab.docking import vina_objective as _vf  # type: ignore
    return _vf


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--seeds", nargs="+",
                    default=["CCO", "C1=CC=CC=C1O",
                             "CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O", "c1ccc(O)cc1O"],
                    help="starting scaffold SMILES")
    ap.add_argument("--iterations", type=int, default=6)
    ap.add_argument("--population", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--max-evals", type=int, default=80)
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1337)
    ap.add_argument("--run-dir", default="runs")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    svc = default_services(seed=args.seed, run_dir=args.run_dir)
    seeds = [Candidate(id=f"seed-{i:02d}", kind="molecule", smi=s)
             for i, s in enumerate(args.seeds)]

    docking_fn = _optional_docking_fn()
    print(f"docking: {'real (Vina adapter wired in)' if docking_fn else 'surrogate (no vina adapter)'}")
    print("objectives: docking + qed + sa  (higher is better)\n")

    bundle, scored = drug_evolve(
        svc, seeds,
        docking_fn=docking_fn,
        iterations=args.iterations,
        population=args.population,
        max_evals=args.max_evals,
    )

    payload = bundle.artifacts[0].payload
    print(f"evals: {payload.get('evals')}  generations: {payload.get('generations')}")
    print(f"front size: {payload.get('n_front')}")
    print("\nTop of the Pareto front (rank-ordered, docking-weighted):")
    print(f"{'#':<4} {'candidate':<14} {'smiles':<34} {'docking':>9} {'qed':>7} {'sa':>7}")
    for i, r in enumerate(scored[:10], 1):
        m = r.get("metrics", {})
        print(f"{i:<4} {r.get('candidate_id','')[:14]:<14} {(r.get('smi') or '')[:34]:<34} "
              f"{m.get('docking', 0):>9.3f} {m.get('qed', 0):>7.3f} {m.get('sa', 0):>7.3f}")

    run_dir = svc["manifest"].run_dir
    svc["manifest"].save()
    print(f"\nrun dir: {run_dir}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
